correctness.rationale: On a circle, the Laplacian resistance kernel has distributional second derivative -2+2 delta. The zero-total signed evaluation measure yields an exact Riesz representer; a second mean-centering fixes the additive constant. Squared evaluation norm is the Hilbert representer energy. Explicit double integrals yield a two-arc strictly concave quadratic, its critical point and maxima including the d=0 and d=1/2 boundary cases. Substitution gives the closed formula, and a polynomial factorization gives the exact nonnegative design deficit. The independent exact-rational checker verified 2765 derivative-profile values and 125 complete rational designs. Computations are corroboration only.

value.rationale: Optimizing two movable weighted normalization anchors on a periodic domain is a natural worst-case pointwise Sobolev stability and sensor design problem. The theorem solves the entire two-mass continuum exactly; its sharp joint deficit quantifies two independently meaningful imperfections (unequal mass and failure of antipodal placement), and it classifies equality evaluations/functions. These constitute a motivated complete classification rather than an arbitrary finite slice.
